_note: All report text is synthetic test data. For each incident: POST /api/v1/incidents with create, PATCH fix_available_at, PUT each stage's report_data, set the clock to reference_clock, then GET /api/v1/incidents/{id}/reports/{stage} for all three stages. early_warning.source: CRA Art. 14(2)(a): early warning, including where applicable the Member States where the product has been made available

vulnerability_notification.source: CRA Art. 14(2)(b): general information on the product, general nature of the exploit and of the vulnerability, corrective or mitigating measures taken and those users can take, and where applicable how sensitive the manufacturer considers the information

final_report.source: CRA Art. 14(2)(c)(i)-(iii): description including severity and impact; where available, information on any malicious actor; details of the security update or other corrective measures

create.rationale: Synthetic AC-08 case: active exploitation of werkzeug 2.2.2 reported against ExampleGateway 1.1.0.

vulnerability_notification.product_information: ExampleGateway 1.1.0, a Python web service that bundles werkzeug 2.2.2.
vulnerability_notification.exploit_nature: Remote, unauthenticated requests with crafted multipart form data.
vulnerability_notification.vulnerability_nature: Excessive resource use while parsing multipart form data.
vulnerability_notification.corrective_measures_taken: Patched build with werkzeug 2.2.3 prepared and under test.
vulnerability_notification.user_mitigations: Limit request body size at the reverse proxy until the update is installed.

final_report.vulnerability_description: werkzeug 2.2.2 multipart parsing lets one request consume a worker's CPU and memory.
final_report.impact: Denial of service for the affected gateway instance.
final_report.malicious_actor_information: No attribution; requests came from a small set of IP addresses.
final_report.corrective_measure_details: ExampleGateway 1.1.1 ships werkzeug 2.2.3; customers were notified by advisory.

create.rationale: Synthetic AC-08 case: exploitation of requests 2.28.2 reported against ExampleGateway 1.1.0.

vulnerability_notification.product_information: ExampleGateway 1.1.0, a Python web service that bundles requests 2.28.2.
vulnerability_notification.vulnerability_nature: Proxy credentials forwarded to the destination server on redirect.
vulnerability_notification.corrective_measures_taken: Upgrade to requests 2.31.0 scheduled for the next patch release.
vulnerability_notification.sensitivity: May be shared with all CSIRTs.

final_report.vulnerability_description: requests 2.28.2 can leak the Proxy-Authorization header to a redirect target.
final_report.impact: Exposure of proxy credentials to third-party servers.
